headline: Unsettled Fronts Draw Fresh Fire
war_summary: The latest ledger finds the war’s pressure concentrated along a few unsettled sectors, with several fronts changing character since the last edition. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest line: its 24-hour event count has eased from 51 to 48, but the newest watch records two events and leaves five Warden, one Colonial, and three neutral bases. Linn Mercy continues under heavy fire, with 16 recorded events in the day and sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates; its present tally stands at eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. Marban Hollow has quickened markedly, rising to 17 daily events from 12, while casualties and enlistments accelerate on both sides. Kuura Strand has also revived, reaching 12 events from 10, with four events in the latest two hours. Nevish Line’s ledger has slipped to 54 events from 56 and shows no fresh movement in that watch, though its combat rates remain intense. Mooring County is a newer concern, posting four events and rapidly rising casualties. Elsewhere, Callahan’s Passage burns with the heaviest combat but records no base movement.
